text: Working with APIs is an essential skill for modern developers. An API allows your program to communicate with another service by sending HTTP requests, usually using methods like GET or POST. The server often responds with data in JSON format, which is easy to read and parse. Before you can access the data, you usually need authentication, such as an API key, to prove your identity. It is also important to respect rate limits, which control how many requests you can make in a certain time. Finally, always handle errors properly, because requests may fail due to network problems or invalid input.
